rows.text: Hanging out in Dolores Park and getting a contact high? Looking for that sweet $$$ treat? Well, search no further, my friend. Welcome to Tartine. The baked goods are definitely tasty, but be prepared to pay for them. Quality comes at a price, and Tartine certainly isn't the cheap-and-cheerful option…
